scope: Facts and implementation readings from the pinned ICEM source and stored data. No forward solve, GEODE mesh, shape derivative or independent convergence study has been completed.

geometry.parameter_units: Lengths in meters, OPERATING_ANGLE in degrees, ScaleR dimensionless. Theta1 and Theta2 in the rotor generator are radians.
geometry.default_conflicts: Stator generator has SW3=0.00064 and Sr1=0.0012 m, but the optimization registration and history iteration 0 use both as 0.001 m. Reconstruct from saved geometry exports and history, not generator defaults alone.
geometry.geometry_export_interpretation: GeoPDEs multipatch NURBS data. Evaluation scripts multiply exported x/y control coefficients by ScaleR; the exports are unscaled. Optimized geometry includes shape-control motion not represented by the 12 scalar parameters.
geometry.readiness: Initial/final NURBS export files are hash-pinned and retrievable; no independent GEODE geometry conversion is implemented.

materials.iron: M27 H(B) points in reference_data.json, 47 pairs in tesla and A/m; 2000 is the source linear initialization relative permeability, not its nonlinear law.
materials.magnet_source: addRemanenceRotor computes Hc=Br/(mu0*mu_r), with direction (cos(angle),sin(angle)); angle pi/2 points along +y in the zero-angle geometry. This is a remanence/coercive-field convention, not Br/mu0 physical magnetization.
materials.iron_interpolation: Mat_Magnetic.fitHBspline uses MATLAB pchip(B,H). The tangent must differentiate the interpolation actually used in the residual.
materials.positive_tangent_condition: For H_vec=nu(s)*B_vec, s=|B|^2, the tangent eigenvalues are nu(s) and nu(s)+2*s*nu'(s)=dH/d|B|. Both must be positive; nu'(s) need not be nonnegative.
materials.origin_and_tail_caveat: Source getMu clamps B<=1e-5 T, whereas getNuPrime clamps only B<=0. The >2.3 T tail has vacuum slope 1/mu0, which need not match the last PCHIP derivative. A globally smooth GEODE law must explicitly document any difference and quantify its effect; do not silently copy an inconsistent clamp into a claimed exact tangent.

excitation.current_convention: Instantaneous phase current I_q=I_peak*sin(phi0+3*beta+phase_offset_q), beta mechanical radians; source API takes beta and phi0 in degrees. Amplitudes are peak, not RMS.
excitation.current_density_rule: Each group's signed current density is I_q*12*sign/area_group. Patch membership and signs are recorded in reference_data.json. Area must be computed from the matching geometry.
excitation.setup_vs_optimization: Iapp=10 A in the setup script is not the saved initial full-current case. Optimization sets Jinit=3.2e6 A/m^2 in the first winding group and derives current from its area. Saved evaluation scales history currents by ScaleR; all three arrays are pinned.

boundaries.index_convention: One-based upstream multipatch boundary identifiers, not GEODE physical tags; mapping still needs reconstruction.

torque.formula: T=-u_stator^T*G_stator*R_beta_derivative*lambda*L; derivative is with respect to mechanical radians.
torque.rotation_matrix_block: [[cos(n*beta), sin(n*beta)],[-sin(n*beta),cos(n*beta)]] in the source harmonic coupling; preserve this convention when reproducing torque sign.
torque.reported_units: N m for the modeled sector, including axial length. Eval scripts use SymMult=1; no factor of six is applied. Compare the stored sector values directly. A full-machine conversion would require a separate justified factor of six.
torque.label_caveat: PMSM_eval_init.m contains a Nm/m plot label, but the function includes L and PMSM_torque_profiles.m labels Nm. Treat the formula and stored normalization as authoritative and record the mismatch.
torque.saved_profile_grid_mechanical_degrees: 0,1,...,19; TorqueData.csv appends 20 degrees by repeating the first row.
torque.optimization_grid_mechanical_degrees: 0,2,...,18; a 20-degree waveform period, not a full 120-degree electrical period.
torque.ripple_definition: Population standard deviation (normalization N), not sample standard deviation or peak-to-peak percentage. Reference objective sums this over three current levels; our proposed squared-ripple objective is a deliberate later change.
torque.validation_limits: Saved output is a reproduction target, not a converged reference or an independently validated GEODE result. Establish spatial and angular error before setting optimization targets.

geode_law_vs_reference.method: Computed, not inferred: benchmarks/motor_nonlinear_m1/pchip_compare.py implements MATLAB pchip (weighted-harmonic interior slopes, one-sided three-point endpoint slopes with shape-preserving clamps) plus the Mat_Magnetic.m 1e-5 T clamp and 1/mu0 tail, and compares it with GEODE's dense dump (examples/m27_law_dump.rs, 100 samples per table segment, log-spaced 1e-8..1e-3 T, 0.0025 T on the tail). H_ref = nu_ref(B)*B. Maxima are over the dump samples.

interior_0p05_to_2p25_T.note: Same Fritsch-Butland interior slopes; identical to round-off.

first_segment_1e-5_to_0p05_T.note: GEODE odd cubic H=c1 B+c3 B^3 vs pchip endpoint slope 426.04 m/H; GEODE nu(0)=397.6613 m/H, reference nu(B<=1e-5)=426.0321 m/H.

last_segment_2p25_to_2p30_T.note: GEODE joins the 1/mu0 tail C1; the reference has a 0.747% dH/dB jump at 2.30 T.

tail_2p30_to_3p0_T.note: Both H_end + (B - B_end)/mu0 with mu0 = 4 pi 1e-7.

geode_law_vs_reference.effect_on_solutions: Not yet quantified in a motor solve; the differences are confined to B < 0.05 T and 2.25..2.30 T.
